target: exact distinction among three frozen source activation histories under idealized observation libraries
aggregation: 384 matched landscapes per source-layout class; layouts are paired, not 768 independent landscapes
computation: New identifications from adding readout B to A = # identified by combined A+B minus # identified by A, because combined information cannot remove previously identified truths.
comparative_readout_availability: The large 107 versus 1 raw-count difference is partly constrained by occupancy-only baselines of 231 versus 348; compare against unresolved cases as denominator.
boundaries: No additional world, ecological data or source-history simulation was run.
The 384 landscapes are constructed as a correlated matched factorial panel, not an ecological sample.
Provenance measurements are idealized earliest-source tags with different dimensionality, cost and feasibility from occupancy snapshots.
Conditional rescue fractions quantify the frozen observation libraries' discrimination, not probability of detecting a real occupied species or population persistence.
No mediation, measurement cost optimality, causal ecological advantage or natural generality is identified.
This report does not reopen the frozen JBI BAM, ecology history-storage or EOG-WF empirical manuscripts.
